sits.name: Nigerian NIN
sits.desc: 11-digit numeric identifier issued by the Federal Inland Revenue Service of Nigeria. Issued by Federal Inland Revenue Service (FIRS). Nigerian NIN consists of exactly 11 digits with no separators, prefixes, or special characters. Issued by FIRS for tax and identification purposes.

sits.name: Ghana Card / NIA PIN
sits.desc: 16-digit numeric identifier issued by Ghana's National Identification Authority (NIA). Format: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX (displayed with hyphens but stored as 16 continuous digits). Issued by National Identification Authority (NIA). Ghana Card is the national identity card of Ghana. The NIA PIN (Personal Identification Number) is a 16-digit unique identifier assigned to each Ghanaian citizen. This SIT targets the numeric sequence regardless of hyphenation in source documents.

sits.name: UAE Mobile Number
sits.desc: UAE mobile numbers consist of 9-12 digits total. Domestic format: 05X XXXXXXX (where X is 0-9, and the first digit after 0 is 0-9). International format: +971 5X XXXXXXX. Common prefixes are 050, 051, 052, 054, 055, 056, 058 for major providers (Etisalat and du). Issued by Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of the United Arab Emirates (TRA). UAE mobile numbers are regulated by TRA. Two main providers are Etisalat and du. The regex matches both domestic (05X-XXXXXXX) and international (+971-5X-XXXXXXX) formats with common operator prefixes.

sits.name: Mauritius NIC
sits.desc: Mauritius NIC format: 1 letter + 6 digits + 1 letter (e.g., A123456B). The first letter typically represents the gender and year of birth, followed by a 6-digit number, and ending with a checksum letter. Issued by Ministry of Civil Status and Nationality (NIC). Mauritius NIC is the primary national identity document. Format consists of 8 characters total: letter-digit-digit-digit-digit-digit-digit-letter. Used for civil registration and identification purposes by the Ministry of Civil Status and Nationality.

sits.name: Zambia NRC
sits.desc: 13-digit Zambian National Registration Card number formatted as 6 digits, 3 digits, 3 digits separated by forward slashes (XXXXXX/XXX/XXX) or in continuous or space-separated format. Issued by Zambia Registration and Licensing Agency (ZRLA). The Zambian NRC is the primary national identification document. Format follows standardized 12-13 digit pattern with typical presentation as XXXXXX/XXX/XXX. Keywords include local issuing authority references and document identification terms specific to Zambia's registration system.

sits.name: Seychelles National ID
sits.desc: 6 digits followed by 2 letters followed by 3 digits (e.g., 123456AB789). Issued by Seychelles Civil Status Division (CSD). Seychelles National Identity Card (Carte d'Identité Nationale) format consists of 6 numerical digits, followed by 2 alphabetical letters representing the island of issue, followed by 3 numerical digits. The two-letter code indicates which island the card was issued from (e.g., MA=Mahé, PA=Praslin, LA=La Digue). The Civil Status Division is the government authority responsible for issuing and managing national identification documents in Seychelles.
